
Currently there are only a few places or situations where lojban is actively spoken, and they are listed below. If you know of others, please add them here, even if it's just in your own household!

* The yearly LogFest at lojbab's house tends to involve a lot of actual lojban conversation. One year (which one?) xod spoke only lojban throughout LogFest!

* Lojban is spoken on the [[jbocre: IRC|IRC]] channel frequently, if not daily.

* Lojban is spoken at the social gatherings of the Lojban Group of Michigan, "le lojbo girzu pe la .micigyn.". which meets every other Wednesday at the home of [[jbocre: Matt Arnold|Matt Arnold]] (AKA [[jbocre: epkat|epkat]] or [[jbocre: Eppcott|Eppcott]]) in Redford, Michigan.
